sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner that the bail granted to respondent Nos.2 and 3 has been cancelled by the learned Sessions Court in Crl.Misc.No.178/2025 filed by the State.
It is therefore submitted that the present petition seeking cancellation of bail has become infructuous.
Placing the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner on record, the petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
